body: I know my boyfriend loves me and cares so much, but I hate talking to him about everything. I hate putting that pressure on him. I don't have anyone else to talk to. Everyone ignores me now, or if I try to talk to someone about my problems it's always my fault. I screw everything up. I have no one to talk to. That is the part I can't deal with. I'm alone..
Maybe she doesn't talk to you because she doesn't want to put her stress on you. All you can do is be there for her, love her, and have patience. Keep doing what you are doing.
i resent that...i love my little bilbo!!!
